claim_being_audited: The model can be certified on the current record only if the municipal permitting limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card; the draft runbook does not justify claiming that no material limitation remains.
decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence supports the action at the policy threshold.
Certification without material caveats requires evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Draft monitoring plans can support risk management but do not eliminate a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
Where a named launch use case remains below target, the safest supportable posture is disclosure rather than claiming no material limitation remains.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card showing explicit disclosure of the municipal permitting limitation.
Provide either evidence that the permitting slice is now at target or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the final approval record for the certification decision, including the exact caveated certification language if certification proceeds before resolution.
specific_concerns: The recommendation is only compliant if certification is paired with an explicit model-card disclosure; a bare 'certify_model' action would overstate what the evidence supports.
There is no admissible evidence that the permitting weakness has been resolved.
There is no admissible evidence of an approved mitigation containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.

The record does not include a final corrected model card or other proof that the required disclosure has actually been made.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that the model may be certified without material caveats is unsupported.
Any implication that the draft runbook itself resolves the disclosure requirement is unsupported.
Any implication that there are no known material limitations in the current draft model card is contradicted by the available evidence.
